text: Yes, a small part of the forest on this property was cleared. In 2023, about 0.7 hectares (1.2% of the total property) of tree cover was lost. However, this loss was primarily from a planted forest area (0.4 hectares of *Eucalyptus* species), not native forest. The event met the corroboration rule, as the JRC 2020 forest cover map agreed with the loss area. Additionally, some smaller patches (0.4 hectares) were lost but were below the minimum event threshold (0.5 hectares) and were not counted. No native forest loss was detected in the mapped area.
